snippets.title: Create an S3 filesystem connection to MinIO
snippets.description: Set up s3fs.S3FileSystem using environment variables to connect to MinIO
snippets.code:
import os
import s3fs

endpoint = os.environ["MINIO_ENDPOINT"]
secure = os.environ.get("MINIO_SECURE", "false").lower() == "true"
protocol = "https" if secure else "http"

fs = s3fs.S3FileSystem(
    key=os.environ["MINIO_ACCESS_KEY"],
    secret=os.environ["MINIO_SECRET_KEY"],
    endpoint_url=f"{protocol}://{endpoint}",
    use_ssl=secure,
)

snippets.title: Full pipeline: read CSV, aggregate, save Parquet
snippets.description: Complete example reading a CSV from MinIO, aggregating with groupby, and saving results as Parquet to another bucket
snippets.code:
import os
import pandas as pd
import s3fs

endpoint = os.environ["MINIO_ENDPOINT"]
secure = os.environ.get("MINIO_SECURE", "false").lower() == "true"

fs = s3fs.S3FileSystem(
    key=os.environ["MINIO_ACCESS_KEY"],
    secret=os.environ["MINIO_SECRET_KEY"],
    endpoint_url=f"{'https' if secure else 'http'}://{endpoint}",
    use_ssl=secure,
)

# Read
with fs.open("raw-data/sales.csv", "rb") as f:
    df = pd.read_csv(f)

# Aggregate
result = df.groupby("category").agg(
    total=("amount", "sum"),
    average=("amount", "mean"),
).reset_index()

# Save
with fs.open("results/agg_sales.parquet", "wb") as f:
    result.to_parquet(f, index=False)
